'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 James Barnes LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[James Barnes]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused|Theed-L-wehaveaplan.gif}}
* '''Username:''' JCBR13
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
